state:
- The decisive URA1 rescue is assigned to primary cytarabine-residual blasts, where stable inducible expression is rarely achievable and cell numbers cannot support the full flux panel. Put URA1 rescue in an engineered salvage-limited line that has already cleared the unbound-exposure and pyrimidine-before-ATP gates, and limit primary specimens to uridine rescue, ubiquinone redox, and isolated-enzyme selectivity.
- Eligibility leaves “elevated respiration” qualitative and genotype unrestricted, so the oxidative-residual context and the stated S4 transfer limit are not operational. Prespecify respiration and isotope-traced fatty-acid-oxidation cutoffs versus matched normal CD34+ cells, and add a genotype stratum or an explicit genotype-transfer falsifier.
- Novelty is postponed to a later literature search, so the ranking does not show what is incremental beyond known complex-III and direct DHODH biology. State in the ranked claim that the proposal is exposure-limited complex III inhibition timed to oxidized-ubiquinone restriction and DHODH-dependent maturation in salvage-poor cytarabine-residual cells, and name which published atovaquone–OXPHOS or ETC–DHODH differentiation result would retire it.
